verdict.rationale: Relay lets admins issue cards with set spend limits, split cash across up to 20 accounts (which can map to departments/programs), and automate transfer rules, giving finance-leads some enforced controls (relay-docs-2, relay-docs-10, relay-docs-25, relay-docs-15). However there's no explicit 'budget' object with automatic hard-stop enforcement per department/program, and community feedback notes some users encountered 'problems with prescribed limits' (relay-comm-2). Missing for 10: dedicated department/program budget creation UI, documented automatic spend-limit enforcement beyond per-card limits, and independent verification that limits reliably hold without glitches.
